ties.note: NW corner of block 190 at 10th St & Ave I (Sealy). Anchored on u24 by the block label 190 and the first numbers of both frontages meeting at this corner (901 on 10th St, 1001 on Ave I); u23 draws the same far-side corner as the only line east of the 80-ft Ave I corridor, opposite block 250 whose 10th-St numbers run 813-823. Implies dx=3084, dy=-13.

SW corner of block 190 at 11th St & Ave I (Sealy) - i.e. the NW corner of the 11th-St frontage of block 190, anchored on u24 by numbers 902/904 (900 block of 11th St) and the 1025/1027 Ave I numbers; on u23 the same far-side corner faces block 250 whose 11th-St number 824 ends the 800 block. Independent of tie-1 and agrees with it (dx 3088 vs 3084, dy -12 vs -13).

Shared strip is the interior of AVE. F OR CHURCH. u22 paper ends at x~3230-3290, well short of the east curb of Ave F (which would be near x~3355 in u22 coords); u23 paper starts at x~25 and its west block line (odd numbers 901-927 / 1001-1027 / 1101-1127) is at x~247. The ~180 px of true overlap contains no drawn object: no hydrant, no lot line, no building. Only the 10-IN W.PIPE dashed line along 12th St crosses the strip (u22 y~3672, u23 y~3675, giving dy~-3 but no x control). No tie recorded.

SW corner of block 248 at 9th St & Ave H (Ball): junction of the Ave-H side line (numbers 823/825/827) with the 9th-St front line whose first even number east of Ave H is 802. On u19 this is the labelled block 248; on u23 the same corner appears in the top sliver (dotted redraw of the block-248 south front) directly above block 249 whose 9th-St numbers start 801/803/805. Implies dx=+31, dy=+3490.

SE corner of block 308 at 9th St & Ave H (Ball), the west counterpart of tie-1 across the 70-ft avenue: anchored by 9th-St numbers 722/724 ending the 700 block and Ave-H side number 828. On u23 the same corner is the dotted sliver corner at the top margin. Independent of tie-1; dx=+40 vs +31, dy=+3493 vs +3490.

SW corner of block 428 at 9th St & Ave E (Post Office): the Ave-E side line (numbers 823/825/827) meeting the 9th-St front line whose first even number east of Ave E is 502. On u18 this is the labelled block 428 (SE quadrant, St Marys Infirmary block 487 two columns west); on u22 the same corner is the top-margin sliver corner immediately NW of the compass rose. Implies dx=-71, dy=+3488.

SE corner of block 488 at 9th St & Ave E (Post Office), the west counterpart of tie-1 across the avenue: 9th-St numbers 422/424 end the 400 block and Ave-E side number 828 runs up the lot line. On u22 the same corner is the sliver corner just above the compass roses west point. Independent of tie-1; dx=-65 vs -71, dy=+3495 vs +3488.

SW corner of block 251 at 12th St & Ave H (Ball) - the block immediately east of the HENRY ROSENBERG FREE SCHOOL block (311) on u23. Corner = Ave-H side line (numbers 1123/1125/1127) meeting the 12th-St front line whose first numbers east of Ave H are 802/804; a fire-alarm box (F.A. in a circle) sits in the intersection just south of it on both sheets, and the 6-IN W.PIPE dashed line runs down Ave H. 14 lot-line verticals along this front line match between u23 and u29 with a constant ~15 px shift, so no wrong-instance ambiguity. Implies dx=+13, dy=+3471.

Centre of the FIRE ALARM box (black ring with pink F.A. disc) standing in 12th St just east of Ave H, drawn on both sheets - unique symbol, only one F.A. in this intersection. Symbol centre is hand-placed so it disagrees with the block-corner tie by ~13 px in x; hence medium.

SW corner of the block on the east side of STRAND (the avenue where 12th-St numbering changes from 1xx to 2xx; first numbers east of it are 202/204, side numbers on the avenue are 1123/1125/1127). 23 lot-line verticals along this 12th-St front line match between u21 and u27 at a constant ~-20 px, so the instance is unambiguous. Implies dx=+24, dy=+3451.

SW corner of block 71 (the BAPTIST CHURCH block on u24) at 12th St & Ave K: Ave-K side line (numbers 1125/1127) meeting the 12th-St front line whose first numbers east of Ave K are 1102/1104. Implies dx=+2975, dy=-1. NOTE: a fire-alarm box (F.A.) is drawn in this avenue on both sheets but at positions differing by ~67 px in x (u58 3031,2443 vs u59 119,2421) - a genuine drawing disagreement; the block corner was used instead.

T.H. hydrant dot standing in AVENUE N (both sheets letter AVENUE N across this strip, u37 with the neighbour number 38 and u38 with 37). Neither sheet draws the other side of the avenue, so this symbol is the only shared feature; hand-placed, so medium. Implies dx=+2976, dy=-19.

Centre of the FIRE ALARM box (black ring with pink F.A. disc) standing in AVENUE L (both sheets letter AVENUE L across this strip, u50 with the neighbour number 51 and u51 with 50). The dashed W.PIPE line crossing ~150 px north gives dy ~ -3 while the symbol centres give dy ~ -25, so the symbol placement disagrees by ~20 px; hence medium. Implies dx=+3048, dy=-25.
